scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the next five unreviewed NVIDIA originals. This is not execution evidence or a permanent exclusion.
linked_reference_caveat: Only these five complete originals were read. Linked schemas, wrappers, templates, SDK references, platform contracts, full licenses, model assets and concrete datasets require separate review. Source claims and historical examples are not fresh measurements. No source instruction was executed.

sources.workflow: Define a PVA operator's behavior contract, independent correctness matrix and evidence record, then use the deterministic finalizer to create and check the OpGen handoff. Resolve conflicts and missing behavior explicitly. This source specifies behavior without implementing the operator or invoking generation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual requested task mode, target generation and SDK, API, project and work paths, requirements and a matching Doctor report or accepted limitations are required. The locked public SDK reference corpus and matching hashes must exist. Templates and handoff requirements determine exact JSON fields. Each requirement needs a test, at least one independent expected result is mandatory, and hardware is required in the planned execution policy. Real hardware execution is not performed by this specification phase. Public input and reference licenses require separate review.
sources.offline_assessment: This is an actual specification and handoff workflow that can in principle run offline without executing GPU or Tegra code, provided its real inputs, locked reference corpus, templates and reviewed deterministic finalizer are supplied. The standard-library container does not contain those artifacts by assumption. A plausible generated specification cannot substitute for the required finalizer checks or resolve unspecified requirements. Planning hardware tests is not hardware verification.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the saved specification and complete requirement-to-test traceability with the actual authoritative inputs, preserving unresolved behavior and conflicts. Independently validate the locked SDK evidence and exact deterministic handoff against original input hashes and counts. Check that configured status requires all blocking issues resolved and both finalizer commands actually pass, without treating that as implementation or hardware success.

sources.workflow: Resolve one exact Run:ai workload in its selected cluster, confirm an in-scope failure, inspect actual status, submitted spec, pods and paginated history, obtain conditional metrics or read-only Kubernetes evidence, and report a quantified evidence-backed category and recurrence. The workflow never changes the workload or cluster.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Tier-one service-account read access to the actual workloads, specs, pods, history and metrics is required. Kubernetes logs and descriptions additionally need separate optional read-only credentials. Exact cluster and workload identity or an unambiguous name/project selection are mandatory. The failure-taxonomy reference must be reviewed. A command string, resource request or exit code alone is not sufficient runtime evidence. Missing measurement fields remain unknown.
sources.offline_assessment: The isolated offline executor lacks the live service and authenticated workload view. Invented tool responses cannot count as actual workload diagnosis. A separately selected analysis of unchanged public captured evidence could be an offline subtask after its provenance, taxonomy and oracle are reviewed, but would not complete live workload discovery or service reads. No real account, tenant or workload was accessed for this review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile the selected workload and cluster with actual captured responses, strongest direct failure signal, all relevant history pages and distinct failure occurrences within the declared window. Distinguish OOM signals from unexplained exit 137, memory limits from requests and observed peaks, and missing events from empty events. Check category and recommendations without claiming an unobserved repair or rerun.

sources.workflow: Run the selected actual AnomalyGen training or inference phases, verify checkpoints and dataset inputs, generate anomaly images, evaluate them, optionally search per-sample parameters, assemble selected samples, and perform declared filtering, regeneration and final evaluation. Training-only and existing-checkpoint inference are separate explicit modes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The original requires a compatible CUDA GPU and Docker with the NVIDIA container toolkit or the stated compatible model environment. Exact image identity comes from the separate version manifest. Real checkpoints, substantial disk storage, appropriately accessible datasets, defect specifications and mode-specific parameters are required. Downloads need authorized model access when applicable. Fine-tune and inference references and the packaged utilities determine exact validation and execution. Mount ownership, write preflight and product-mode guard prerequisites are explicit.
sources.offline_assessment: The default CPU standard-library container cannot train, generate images, embed features or compute the specified learned scores. Already local model artifacts could avoid fresh network retrieval in a separately reviewed GPU runtime, but offline mode does not supply that runtime or its weights. JSONL preparation or CSV aggregation would require explicit narrow task selection and reviewed helpers; neither is full pipeline completion. No GPU work, package installation or source helper execution occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile actual mode, checkpoint identity, input pairs and per-defect allocation with fresh generation and evaluation artifacts from each executed phase. Check selected sample provenance, intended counts, regeneration fallbacks and final canonical evaluation. Retain guardrail flags and never equate a counted image file with an admissible image, because blocked output can be blacked out while retaining its slot. A complete sample count does not prove all samples pass the quality threshold.

sources.workflow: Run actual AnomalyGenNext inference and pseudo-labeling from a completed prepared input set or native testcase, then publish validated fine-grained and binary COCO annotations. This leaf neither trains the model nor admits outputs to a detector training set.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The matching container, CUDA GPUs, base and task checkpoint roots, required tokenizer, processor and DINO assets, actual image-mask pairs and matching recipe are required. Enabled guardrails need additional model assets. Prepared integrity hashes and requested row counts must match. The execution and container-runtime references and selected platform launch contract need review. Offline generation starts only after actual asset and mount validation.
sources.offline_assessment: The default isolated Python runtime has no compatible GPU model stack or checkpoint tree. A fabricated COCO file, copied image or planned launch cannot establish the requested inference. A separately chosen saved-annotation validation subtask could be bounded offline work with real public artifacts and a frozen schema, but is not generation or publication by this leaf. No guardrail setting was changed and no model was invoked.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify actual checkpoint and prepared-input provenance, requested rows, generated and blocked counts, pseudo-label coverage, category mappings and every bounding box against the saved image dimensions. Check both native and binary COCO files and persistent output locations. Preserve the selected guardrail mode and confirm that the training pool remains unchanged. Successful file emission alone is not verified generation or usable annotation quality.

sources.workflow: Run a bounded disk-backed retrieval-improvement loop: discover the actual PAS archives, approve an immutable platform and training configuration, rebuild and split the dataset, embed the pool, evaluate the baseline, analyze gaps, mine and select without evaluation leakage, retrain and re-evaluate until the approved stop condition, then commit and audit terminal state and report actual checkpoint and metric evidence.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A supported actual TAO platform with accessible NVIDIA GPUs, both real PAS export archives, the packaged workflow and platform adapters, a suitable control Python environment, explicit iteration or time budget, selected fine-tuning method and writable approved workspace are required. Execution runtimes are distinct from the control environment. Required credentials depend on model access and platform rather than being universal. Typed schemas, preflight, state, metric and platform references require separate review. Runtime actions follow the exact approved plan.
sources.offline_assessment: The current offline standard-library executor lacks the model training stack, archives and GPU platform. Local-only prepared assets may support a separately approved offline GPU run, but cannot be assumed. Draft configurations, mocked jobs, synthetic embeddings or copied checkpoint names do not complete this workflow. A bounded deterministic audit of supplied state could be a separately selected subtask after the actual scripts and schema are reviewed, not a replacement for training and held-out evaluation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check immutable configuration and archive identities, real platform job bindings, fresh stage outputs and exactly-once committed transitions against the approved iteration budget. Independently reconcile split leakage, selected training history, actual model checkpoints and the operator-directed metric from the exact iteration's retained CSV. Require the terminal audit and correct stop reason. Maximum-iteration completion does not prove that the retrieval target was met, and a hard stop remains failure rather than success.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
